appDescription.message: Paste Markdown, tidy it up, and copy it.

toggleSourceTitle.message: Show or hide the Markdown source

copyMarkdownTitle.message: Copy the source text exactly as it is

copyRichTitle.message: Copy with formatting, for pasting into Teams, email, and similar apps

copySelectionTitle.message: Copy only the range selected in the source, with formatting

downloadTitle.message: Download the source as an .md file (the file stays on your PC)

clearTitle.message: Erase the content and the undo history

notSavedDetail.message: Closing or reloading this tab discards what you entered. Only files you download stay on your PC.

previewEmptySub.message: Check Markdown copied from an AI answer or elsewhere, fix it if needed, and copy it with formatting.

fenceDetected.message: The whole text is wrapped in a Markdown code fence.

fenceApplied.message: Showing the content without the outer fence (the source is unchanged).

manualLarge.message: Automatic updates are paused because the text is large ($1 characters).

manualSlow.message: Automatic updates are paused because conversion is slow.

renderFailed.message: The preview could not be created. Your source is still intact.

removedHtml.message: $1 disallowed HTML element(s) are not shown.

imagesReplaced.message: $1 image(s) are not loaded and are shown as alternative text.

copiedImages.message: $1 image(s) were replaced with alternative text.

copyFailed.message: Could not copy. Your content is unchanged. Please try again.

selectionRequired.message: Select a range in the source first

selectionNeedsSource.message: Show the source and select a range first

downloaded.message: Downloaded. The file is saved on your PC.

clearConfirmBody.message: This erases the source, the preview, and the undo history. It cannot be undone.

aboutPrivacy.message: Text you enter is handled only inside this tab. It is never saved or sent anywhere. Only your settings are saved: the default on/off state of extra syntax and whether to paste formatted text.

fmtMoreTitle.message: More formatting (italic, strikethrough, quote, image, horizontal rule)

syntaxIntro.message: Checked syntax is interpreted in this tab's preview and formatted copy. The source is not changed.

featureAlertsHelp.message: > [!NOTE] at the top of a quote shows it as a note box.

featureFootnotesHelp.message: Text[^1] and [^1]: note collect notes at the end.

featureMathHelp.message: $1 and $2 are kept apart from other syntax and shown as text. Formulas are not drawn.

featureContainersHelp.message: Text between ::: note and ::: is shown in a box.

featureWikiLinksHelp.message: [[page]] and [[page|label]] are shown as links (they do not open, because the browser cannot open your files).

featureDefinitionListsHelp.message: A term followed by a line starting with : shows a term and its description.

saveDefault.message: Save as the default for new tabs

syntaxSaved.message: Saved as the default for new tabs

syntaxSaveFailed.message: Could not save the default. It is applied to this tab.

selectionOutside.message: Link or footnote definitions outside the selection are not included.

licenseMit.message: This app is released under the MIT License.

pasteHtmlHelp.message: When you paste formatted (HTML) text, convert it to Markdown automatically.

pasteNote.message: Paste an AI answer or other formatted text, and its headings, bold, lists, tables, links and code come in as Markdown. Text without formatting and Markdown source are pasted as they are. When this is off, only the text is pasted, as before.

pasteSaveFailed.message: Could not save the paste settings

pasteTooLong.message: The text is long, so it was pasted as plain text without converting the formatting
